culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investments at fair value (cost of $ 637,306 and $ 720,787, respectively) | $ | 613,258 | $ | 714,200

findings.detail: PP03 flagged twelve holdings retained under report_date 2026-03-31 even though the cited schedule block ties to the December 31, 2025 investment total.

citation.quoted_text: Aramark Services, Inc. prior-period schedule row retained as a 2026-03-31 holding.

rationale: The raw source has paired March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025 columns. The schedule block containing the cited Aramark row rolls to Total First Lien Debt / Total Investment Portfolio cost 720,787 and fair value 714,200, which matches the December 31, 2025 column in table 301, not the March 31, 2026 column of cost 637,306 and fair value 613,258. Retaining these prior-period rows under report_date 2026-03-31 is a comparative-period leak, so the PP03 flag is a real data error.
